title: Massimo Anelli
text:
I am an Associate Professor at Bocconi University, where I direct the Dondena AI and Society Initiative (DAISI) and serve as Academic Director of the BSc in International Politics and Government and of the Bocconi–HEC double-degree in Data, Society and Organizations.
My research asks how technological change reshapes labor markets, families, and politics — and what that means for the people on the receiving end of it. I work on automation and artificial intelligence, migration, education, and the political consequences of economic shocks.
I am a Research Fellow at CESifo, IZA, the ROCKWOOL Foundation Berlin, IGIER, and the Dondena Centre.
